# 1 Chronicles 24 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 24 (31 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.4 — "heads of mighty men" vs. "leading men"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "heads of mighty men" / **PNEUMA:** "leading men"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "leading men" — *gevarim* here denotes men of standing, not warriors.

---

## V.6 — Alternating selection process
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "one house being chosen for Eleazar and one for Ithamar" / **PNEUMA:** "alternating fairly"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Adds "alternately" to the formal rendering to clarify the Hebrew procedure.

---

## V.31 — "chief corresponding to his younger brother"
- **LOGOS:** "the chief of each house on the same footing as his younger brother" / **PNEUMA:** "The oldest family was treated the same as the youngest"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering — preserves the concrete "elder/younger brother" phrasing.

---
*— SOPHIA*
